reason: The tiled NEON transpose directly tests a different way to perform the required timed A conversion, though the prior TB wrapper was rejected and its conversion cost was not isolated. The four-step unroll and K-pair schedule are distinct schedule proposals, but prior unroll evidence did not pass promotion. The 288-byte padding proposal has no cache evidence; prior 272-byte padding was not promoted. TA adds a timed B transpose while retaining both generated packing paths. Half-band scratch repeats a traversal pattern that was not promoted and adds packing work. Fusion repeats the A transpose across 16 panels. These are rankings of unverified proposals, not measured speedups.
